Class AbstractModel

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.provider.AbstractModel
Direct Known Subclasses:
AnthropicModel, GeminiModel, OpenAiCompatibleModel, OpenAiModel
public abstract class AbstractModel extends Object
The abstract base class for a specific AI model (e.g., "gemini-1.5-pro-latest"). In the V2 architecture, this class is the definitive entry point for generating content, creating a clean, object-oriented API where the model itself is the actor.
Author:
anahata-gemini-pro-2.5

      public boolean hasDiscrepancy()

    • resetFromApi

      public void resetFromApi() throws IOException
      Resets this locally registered model entity from its cached API model counterpart and persists changes to disk.
      Throws:

      IllegalStateException - if this model is not registered or no cached API model is available.

    • countTokens

      public abstract int countTokens(AbstractToolCall<?,?> toolCall)
      Counts the number of tokens consumed by the given tool call in the context window.

      Model subclasses override this method to serialize the tool call into its exact wire-format (JSON, Protobuf, etc.) to ensure 100% accurate billing.

      Parameters:
      toolCall - The tool call to count tokens for.
      Returns:
      The precise token count.

    • countTokens

      public abstract int countTokens(byte[] data, String mimeType)
      Counts the number of tokens consumed by raw binary data based on its MIME type and model-specific multimodal billing rules.

      This generic signature provides complete decoupling from domain part classes, allowing the model to tokenize any binary payload (such as blob parts or tool attachments).

      Parameters:
      data - The raw binary data.
      mimeType - The MIME type of the binary data (e.g. "image/png").
      Returns:
      The precise token count, or 0 if no model is active or the data is null.

    • countTokens

      public abstract int countTokens(AbstractToolResponse<?> toolResponse)
      Counts the number of tokens consumed by the given tool execution response.

      Model subclasses override this to serialize the response into its exact wire-format (Protobuf FunctionResponse, JSON, etc.) to ensure 100% accurate billing.

      Parameters:
      toolResponse - The tool response to count tokens for.
      Returns:
      The exact number of tokens.

    • matches

      public boolean matches(Pattern queryPattern, Set<ResponseModality> targetModalities)
      Checks if this model matches a search query (regex or substring) AND all target response modalities.
      Parameters:
      queryPattern - Optional compiled regex pattern to match against model attributes. If null, matches all.
      targetModalities - Optional set of required response modalities. If not empty, the model must support ALL specified modalities.
      Returns:
      true if the model satisfies all active criteria (AND logic).
